rootCause.summary: resolveFixedScreenCoverageGeometry misclassifies the TOP-anchored 'story-debug-trigger' HUD rect as a BOTTOM reservation, collapsing the usable vertical band to bottom=52 < top=79.6. geometry.valid is then unsatisfiable every frame, so fixed-screen coverage is never valid, no camera cell transfer can ever be produced, and ch1-fixed can never advance.

arithmetic.result: bottom 52 < top 79.6 -> empty band; validity test requires bodyTop-offsetY >= 79.6 AND bodyBottom-offsetY <= 52 while bodyBottom > bodyTop by construction -> unsatisfiable for ANY fov/rig/DPR/body extent
arithmetic.offsetY: 0 (offsetY is only non-zero when viewport.touch && w>h; this run is non-touch)

chain: storyHudLayout.readEarlyFeedReservations emits a rect with id 'story-debug-trigger' (the ?story= debug disclosure button, measured at top=66 bottom=110, i.e. top-right under the camera-status block)

sideLens.resolveFixedScreenCoverageGeometry whitelists only feed-work-order / feed-camera-status / story-journal-trigger for the TOP branch; every other id-bearing rect falls to the ELSE branch and drives bottom = min(bottom, rect.top - 14)
sampleFixedScreenCoverage yields coverage.valid === false, so cellId/anchorCenter stay frozen at 0, transfer stays null, transferSequence stays 0

computeRigFrame uses `coverage?.anchorCenter ?? 0`, so the fixed-screen camera stays bolted at cell 0 for the whole beat while the worker walks ~29 m to screen-right and off frame (matches the captured stills: static wide shot, no worker)

storyDirector ch1-fixed case guards the entire cell/transfer block behind `if (coverage?.valid)`, so camCell, d.fixedCells, fixedTransferAwaitingPaint and completeFoundationalObjective('ch1:fixed:cross-camera-cell') are all unreachable
